Copying the app to $RUNNER_TEMP and running it there with node off PATH would match the clause.

Release workflow, read: triggers v* tags + workflow_dispatch only; build 15 min, release 5 min; contents: read for build, write only for the draft release; actions pinned by tag (v4), not by SHA; only an arm64 Mac build (Intel Macs get no file); Windows: postject edits a signed node.exe, so the exe carries a broken signature rather than none (SmartScreen still shows the 'More info, Run anyway' box the README describes); the smoke test leaves the app running until the job ends.

package.json keeps "private": true, so `npm publish` would refuse it; the README says npx works once published. Publishing is out of scope.
